statements.text: Setup refuses to run without a vector width. It says so before it writes anything.
statements.notes: ValueError naming embedding_dimension. A preview without a width runs and reports no width plan. Unit test on fakes.

statements.text: Setup refuses to start while the caller has an open transaction on the connection. A preview refuses too.
statements.notes: CallerTransactionOpenError when $TLEVEL > 0 (4.7.0). Driver autocommit off with $TLEVEL 0 is no refusal. Setup saves step by step and compiles classes, which no rollback undoes.

statements.text: A user who lacks a right to make tables or routines is stopped at the first statement that needs it. The error names the user, the schema and the right.
statements.notes: IVGSchemaError.no_privilege; SQLCODE -99. The message says "Nothing was created" only when no earlier statement succeeded. Assumes the IRIS error text (P-0105).

statements.text: A bad schema name is refused before any database call. The error names the rule it breaks.
statements.notes: ValueError for empty, not [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*, SQLUser in any case, or a leading %. ADR-0016 writes [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*; code and spec allow lower case.

statements.text: A name whose class package is, or lies under, one of the product's own code packages is refused.
statements.notes: Graph.KG, IVG, IVGC. Graph_KG itself is the default and allowed.

statements.text: Setup refuses a schema whose class package already holds classes the product did not make. Nothing is made.
statements.notes: refuse_package_clash, before any DDL; empty for Graph_KG. Runs in a preview too.

statements.text: With no record and the product's tables in another schema, or in several, setup refuses unless the caller named one. It lists each schema with its row counts and saves nothing.
statements.notes: FR-009. A schema counts when it has both base tables nodes and rdf_edges (views do not count). A preview refuses the same way. Named means schema_prefix= or IVG_SCHEMA_PREFIX.

statements.text: Setup is refused when the record names another schema. So is a deploy. Nothing is read or loaded first.
statements.notes: 4.6.0 R173: a namespace recorded as RAG had got Graph_KG's schema classes from a deploy that never read the record. A preview refuses too.

statements.text: When the record names another schema, every public call of the engine is refused. The error names both schemas, and nothing is written.
statements.notes: IVGSchemaError.mismatch. The e2e case compares a whole-namespace snapshot before and after.

statements.text: With no record and no marker routine, every public call is refused. The error says which of three cases it is.
statements.notes: FR-006a; 4.6.0 R201. Each message names initialize_schema() and says it writes, and its preview.

statements.text: A namespace with none of the product's classes, tables or globals is called never set up.
statements.notes: IVGSchemaError.never_set_up.

statements.text: A namespace that holds a legacy object is set up by an old release and not yet brought up to date.
statements.notes: Any class of the legacy list defined in ^oddDEF.

statements.text: Some namespaces hold some of the product's own parts and no legacy object. Such a namespace holds a setup that did not finish.
statements.notes: Graph.KG.PageRank or Graph.KG.Meta, the schema's nodes or rdfedges table class, or ^KG or ^IVG.Deploy.

statements.text: A schema class name may be taken in the class package by a class the product did not make. Then the deploy loads nothing.
statements.notes: Known by the missing IVGSCHEMACLASS parameter in ^oddDEF. Never applies to Graph_KG.

statements.text: The core vector search procedure may fail to be made. Unless its width is the cause, setup stops with an error.
statements.notes: kg_KNN_VEC; SQLCODE -260 is a warning in failed. RuntimeError after the record of the others is saved.

statements.text: A right whose grantee or target has an odd name is refused before it is granted.
statements.notes: ValueError; names are put into GRANT text unquoted.

statements.text: If a right is still held after it was taken away, setup raises.
statements.notes: RuntimeError naming the subject and grantors.

statements.text: If a ledger table is missing after setup, setup raises. It copies no rows.
statements.notes: RuntimeError naming the rows left behind.

statements.text: Legacy removal will not drop a thing if the caller has work not yet saved. That work is an open transaction.
statements.notes: 4.7.0; only for dry_run=False. The listing is not refused.

statements.text: A failed edge rescue stops setup, even though other deploy failures do not.
statements.notes: The rescue table is the only copy of the edges.

statements.text: An edge table in the way that holds rows the side table lacks is never dropped. Setup raises instead.
statements.notes: The message says how to move them by hand.

statements.text: A step name that is not one of the four is refused before any step runs.
statements.notes: ValueError naming the known steps.

statements.text: The upgrade refuses to start while the caller has an open transaction. A preview does not refuse.
statements.notes: CallerTransactionOpenError (4.7.0).

statements.text: If a step's save fails, the step is rolled back and the upgrade raises an error that names it.
statements.notes: Before 4.7.0 a refused commit was logged at DEBUG and the next step ran.

statements.text: The re-key refuses an old key name that is not plain. It hands back no statements then.
statements.notes: ValueError "not a constraint name this migration can drop" for a legacy_node_keys name outside [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; uq_nodes_nodeid is skipped, as the list always drops it.

statements.text: A statement with an unknown expected outcome is refused when it is declared.
statements.notes: ValueError; expects is ddl, rows-changed or rows-selected.

statements.text: A run with the wrong number of inputs sends nothing to IRIS.
statements.notes: ValueError before a cursor opens.

statements.text: A caller who lacks the right is refused with SQL's privilege error, which names the table.
statements.notes: SQLCODE -99 "User X lacks SELECT on T".

statements.text: A refused or failed read inside a routine raises. It does not come back as an empty answer.
statements.notes: RaiseIfRefused (4.6.0 R279).

statements.text: Removing a graph, removing all graphs and starting an adjacency rebuild are refused when the lock is not granted in 5 seconds. Nothing is written.
statements.notes: Error status "the writer lock ... was not granted in 5 seconds"; the eraser and BuildKG raise it.

statements.text: A rebuild of the interned snapshot waits for any other one. It is refused after 900 seconds.
statements.notes: ^IVG.NKGBuild, exclusive; NKGBUILDWAIT. Also EnsureNKG (410-413).

statements.text: A name that cannot be a graph key is refused before the check runs.
statements.notes: ValueError from validate_graph_name.

statements.text: An empty model name is refused. A writer with no model gives no model key instead.
statements.notes: ValueError. Unit test.

statements.text: A way of making vectors that is not one of the three known ways is refused.
statements.notes: MECHANISMS = iris-embedding-config, sentence-transformers, external (FR-004). Unit test.

statements.text: A write is refused when its identity clashes with its registry row. Nothing is written then.
statements.notes: EmbeddingIdentityConflict (a ValueError), message names the graph. Live IRIS test.

statements.text: A write is refused when the registry is there but cannot be read.
statements.notes: Intended. get_embedding_identity answers None on any read error, so enforce_embedding_identity lets the write through; _read_route raises for anything but SQLCODE -30 (4.6.0 R161).

statements.text: Setting another model on a claimed row is refused.
statements.notes: Live IRIS test.

statements.text: Setting an identity with no model is refused. Only adopting writes a row with no model key.
statements.notes: Live IRIS test.

statements.text: An identity can be set only on a table that holds node vectors. Any other table is refused.
statements.notes: Accepts the three legacy names or a kg_emb_<16 hex> name; an edge route (kg_eemb_) is refused too. Live IRIS test.

statements.text: Setup will not change the width of an empty vector table unless asked. It never changes the width of a table that holds vectors.
statements.notes: EmbeddingIdentityConflict before setup writes (4.7.0 row 25); initialize_schema(rewidth=True) re-declares an empty column. e2e test, live IRIS.

statements.text: Making a new route is refused inside a transaction the caller opened.
statements.notes: CallerTransactionOpenError (4.7.0). Store the first vector of a pair outside the transaction.

statements.text: A route table that outlived its row at another width is refused, and no row is added.
statements.notes: EmbeddingIdentityConflict naming both widths. Unit tests.

statements.text: Any other failed registry read raises. It never falls back to the legacy table.
statements.notes: 4.6.0 R161. Unit tests.

statements.text: Storing a node's vector is refused when the node is not in that graph.
statements.notes: ValueError; a failed check raises RuntimeError saying nothing was written (4.6.0 R276).

statements.text: A vector whose width differs from its route's width is refused, and the error names the graph.
statements.notes: Unit test (fake) and e2e (live IRIS).

statements.text: A batch that holds two widths is refused before anything is written.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: A batch refused for a missing node leaves no new route behind.
statements.notes: Intended (SYS-I3). The route is made and saved before the per-item node check.

statements.text: The tool that fills the second legacy table checks the identity too. It must not skip it.
statements.notes: Intended. VectorOptimizer.migrate_to_optimized inserts row by row with no registry check and reports success with a failed count.

statements.text: A failed count or listing raises. It never answers zero or an empty list instead.
statements.notes: 4.6.0 R176 and R276. A missing table still counts zero.

statements.text: A query vector whose width differs from the route's is refused before any search runs. The error names both widths.
statements.notes: ValueError. Uses the catalog width when the row has none (4.6.0 R223). Unit test and e2e test (live IRIS).

statements.text: A search that names a graph or a model is refused when only an IVF index could answer it.
statements.notes: ValueError. An explicit graph "" still reaches IVF.

statements.text: A table search of a route with no graph named is refused before it runs.
statements.notes: FR-041. Tested for node routes; the name test misses edge routes (kg_eemb_). Unit test.

statements.text: An identity clash during a bulk embed is raised to the caller, not only counted.
statements.notes: Intended. Only CallerTransactionOpenError is re-raised; EmbeddingIdentityConflict is logged and counted.

statements.text: Queuing a node that already waits for another graph is refused. The count of queued items shows it.
statements.notes: Live IRIS test.

statements.text: Work for a model that the registry refuses is not queued. Nothing is queued then.
statements.notes: FR-011. Live IRIS test.

statements.text: An entry that asks for a model other than the worker's is marked failed, with the reason. The rest of the batch goes on.
statements.notes: Live IRIS test.

statements.text: The server worker marks an entry failed when its node is not in its graph, or the graph has no route.
statements.notes: Live IRIS tests.

statements.text: An inventory that cannot read a registry that is there raises. It does not give an empty report.
statements.notes: Intended. Any read error answers [].

statements.text: Listing by an unknown reason is refused, not answered empty.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: Placing is refused when the graph and model have no route. It never makes one.
statements.notes: Unit tests.

statements.text: Placing is refused when the row's width or number type differs from the route's.
statements.notes: EmbeddingIdentityConflict. Unit tests.

statements.text: Placing is refused when the node is not in that graph.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: A chooser that names a graph not holding the node has declined, and the row goes to the quarantine.
statements.notes: e2e test.

statements.text: The upgrade is refused when the caller has a transaction open.
statements.notes: 4.7.0; dry runs are allowed.

statements.text: If the node tables cannot be keyed by graph without a guess, the upgrade moves no vectors and says why.
statements.notes: structural_blockers, key_conflicts, node_key_blockers (FR-036).

statements.text: The node store step checks first. If a source table has no graph column, or a rebuild step is missing, it stops and drops nothing.
statements.notes: RuntimeError. A dry run compiles nothing.

statements.text: A new run refuses a staging or quarantine table for edge vectors that holds rows at another width. An empty one is made again at the new width.
statements.notes: prepare_edge_vectors through _reset_wrong_width_tables: the kg_EdgeEmbeddings staging table and edge_vector_quarantine, width from get_embedding_dimension; a RuntimeError names the table and both widths, else a warning and a DROP before the CREATE. Coverage (ontology-2): prepare_edge_vectors.

statements.text: Asking for an index name the engine does not know is refused, and the error lists the known names.
statements.notes: IndexNotFoundError.

statements.text: Building or searching a neighborhood vector index is refused, since it is not built yet.
statements.notes: NotImplementedError (spec 181, not in the tree).

statements.text: Building an IVF index is refused when the graph and model have no route, or the route has no vectors.
statements.notes: ValueError. Unit test.

statements.text: Adding to an IVF index that does not exist is refused.
statements.notes: ValueError. e2e test.

statements.text: A tree index refuses a measure it cannot compute. It writes nothing then.
statements.notes: cosine, l2, l1, dot, chebyshev (4.7.0 row 8b: mahalanobis was scored as cosine).

statements.text: A PLAID build with one word vector of another width is refused. Nothing is written.
statements.notes: 4.6.0 R089. Insert and search do not check width.

statements.text: Global PageRank refuses a damping value outside zero to one. It also refuses fewer than one round.
statements.notes: ValueError naming the argument; the class methods throw IVG 5001. Unit test without a database; e2e needs live IRIS.

statements.text: A refusal by the database is raised as an error that keeps its SQL code.
statements.notes: RuntimeError "kg_PAGERANK failed (SQLCODE -99): ...". Unit test, mocks only.

statements.text: A name that cannot be used for a graph is refused before anything runs.
statements.notes: "0" and control characters (validate_graph_name mirrors GraphKey.Validate). Unit test.

statements.text: Damping outside zero to one is refused, and so is a round limit below one. The error names the setting.
statements.notes: Every PPR entry point, SQL function kg_PPR included. Unit test without a database; e2e needs live IRIS.

statements.text: A negative weight for reverse edges is refused.
statements.notes: ValueError "reverse_edge_weight". Unit test.

statements.text: An empty list of start nodes is refused. A single string, or a start node that is not a string, is refused too.
statements.notes: ValueError for none, TypeError for the wrong type (4.6.0 R050). The contract test uses a live engine; the unit test does not.

statements.text: A badly formed list of left-out edge types is refused.
statements.notes: A string instead of a list, or an entry with more than one dot.

statements.text: With a round limit, a graph that needs more rounds is refused rather than answered with unsettled groups.
statements.notes: "WCC did not converge in n rounds". Test needs live IRIS.

statements.text: A direction other than out, in or both is refused before anything is read.
statements.notes: Pydantic Literal in the engine; CheckDirection on the server.

statements.text: A store whose degree method takes no graph fails for a named graph. It never answers the default graph's degrees instead.
statements.notes: The graph keyword is sent only for a named graph, so the old signature raises TypeError.

statements.text: A negative sample size is refused. So is an unknown direction, or a hop limit out of range.
statements.notes: max_hops 0..1000; mem_budget_mb 16..8192. Unit test.

statements.text: Closeness has two formulas, harmonic and classical. Any other name is an error.
A store that lacks a centrality method refuses the call. The error says it is not built.
statements.notes: NotImplementedError naming the store.

statements.text: The vector-ranked walk is refused with a not-implemented error. No store the product ships has it.
statements.notes: bfs_vector_rerank: a hook for third-party stores (4.6.0 R145).

statements.text: The server's closeness and betweenness refuse a direction other than out, in or both. Betweenness also refuses a hop limit that is not a whole number of zero or more. Each refusal is an error text with no scores.
statements.notes: Answers 'ERROR:direction must be out, in or both, not ...' and 'ERROR:maxHops must be a whole number 0 or more, not ...' (4.6.0 round 3; before, any other value walked out). The kg_Betweenness and kg_Closeness SQL functions throw IVG 5001 on an ERROR: answer. Coverage (ontology-2): the refusals of the server closeness and betweenness methods.

statements.text: Leiden settings out of range are refused, such as a gamma of zero or less.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: A failure on the path that ran is raised. It is never answered as no communities.

A call to the Arno library over SQL raises a library error when the library is missing or the function name is unknown. It does the same for a wrong count of arguments, or for an answer that is an error. A long answer is fetched in parts.
statements.notes: arno_call(conn, fn_name, *args, schema): ArnoError when arno_available is False, fn_name is not one of the 12 kernels of _SQL_FN_DISPATCH, len(args) is not the wrapper's arity, the SELECT fails, the answer is NULL or starts 'ERROR:'; a *_run answer 'OK:<len>' is fetched with ivg_arno_zf_get_result_chunk in 30,000-character parts. Called by the store's triangle, SCC, k-core and Leiden library paths, which fall back on ArnoError. Coverage (ontology-2): arno_call.

statements.text: The snapshot procedures refuse to run once a named graph has an edge. The error names the engine method that answers for the default graph.
statements.notes: CALL ivg.betweenness, closeness, eigenvector, leiden, triangleCount, scc, kcore (4.6.0 R184). Unit test with mocks; e2e needs live IRIS.

statements.text: They also refuse any request scoped to one graph, even the default graph.
statements.notes: USE GRAPH, including USE GRAPH ''. Unit test.

statements.text: The server functions behind them refuse in the same way, so plain SQL cannot get a mixed answer either.
statements.notes: RefuseMergedGraphs, IVG 5001 (4.6.0 R196). Unit test reads source text; e2e needs live IRIS.

statements.text: With no snapshot built, a snapshot procedure fails and says so.
statements.notes: "ERROR:^NKG not built", SQLCODE -149 (4.6.0 R166). Unit test with a mock connection.

statements.text: Each snapshot procedure checks its options as its engine method does. An unknown option name, or a value that the method refuses, is refused.
statements.notes: CENTRALITY_ALLOWED_KEYS and COMMUNITY_ALLOWED_KEYS (_validate_centrality_proc_map, _validate_community_proc_map: a ValueError naming the unknown and the allowed keys), then _procedure_options runs each option through the engine method's model (4.6.5). Procedures ivg.betweenness, ivg.closeness, ivg.eigenvector, ivg.leiden, ivg.trianglecount, ivg.scc, ivg.kcore. Coverage (ontology-2): ivg.closeness, ivg.eigenvector, ivg.leiden, ivg.trianglecount, ivg.scc.

statements.text: It refuses damping outside zero to one, or fewer than one round.
A login that cannot write the walk's work area is refused. The message names the area and the access it needs.
statements.notes: <PROTECT> on ^ArnoKG; the namespace database at RW (4.6.0 R244).

statements.text: A weighted search refuses any weight but the stored one, and any direction but out, in or both.
statements.notes: CheckWeightProp, CheckDirection (4.6.0 R154).

statements.text: Only one rebuild runs at a time. A rebuild that waits too long for another fails and says so.
statements.notes: Lock ^IVG.NKGBuild, NKGBUILDWAIT seconds.

statements.text: A sync whose rebuild fails raises an error that names the server method.
The product's SQL functions open no other library file. They also refuse to call a function they do not use.
The old call that asked the Arno library to build the snapshot is refused. It calls nothing and answers an error that names the server's own build.
statements.notes: NKGAccelLoader.BuildNKGRust answers {"error": "kg_build_nkg is deprecated (arno-callout 1.2.0) ... Graph.KG.Traversal.BuildNKG"}, a JSON text, not a throw. Coverage (ontology-2): NKGAccelLoader.BuildNKGRust, NKGAccel.BuildNKGRust.

statements.text: An entry is valid only with a revision of one or more. It also needs at least five test graphs and five repeats.
statements.notes: Also the version form "arno-callout X.Y.Z+sha" and a sha256 per platform. Unit test.

statements.text: The record is not valid if it names an algorithm that may not go to a native reader. Betweenness is one.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: The gate fails when the record claims a higher revision than the library reports.
statements.notes: FR-010. Unit test.

statements.text: With the require switch set, a missing library fails the gate instead of skipping it.
statements.notes: IVG_REQUIRE_ARNO=1. Unit test.

statements.text: Enable is refused if its process has an open transaction. The check is skipped when the ledger is on.
statements.notes: Error code transaction_open (LedgerTransactionOpenError). The enabled fast path answers before the $TLEVEL test. Live test.

statements.text: The Python enable refuses a caller transaction that holds a write. It sends nothing.
statements.notes: 4.7.0. Autocommit off with nothing written yet ($TLEVEL 0) is not refused. Live e2e test.

statements.text: Enable waits up to 30 seconds for the head lock, then gives up and changes nothing.
statements.notes: Error code lock_timeout (LedgerLockTimeoutError). Live test.

statements.text: Head reports the ledger as broken when it is enabled but holds no revision.
statements.notes: Error code inconsistent (LedgerInconsistencyError).

statements.text: A commit gives up after 30 seconds without the head lock and changes nothing.
statements.notes: Error code lock_timeout; counted as rej_lock_timeout. Live test.

statements.text: A commit is refused when the ledger was never enabled.
statements.notes: Error code not_enabled; not counted in the stats row.

statements.text: A commit is refused while the ledger is disabled.
statements.notes: Error code disabled (LedgerDisabledError), counted as rej_disabled. Live test.

statements.text: A retry key that is bound to a different fingerprint is refused.
statements.notes: Error code idempotency_conflict, with the head. A new message or correlation id alone is not a conflict (same test). Live test.

statements.text: A commit whose expected head is not the head is refused as stale. The answer names the head.
statements.notes: Error code stale_head; StaleHeadError.current_head. Live test with two processes; the unit test uses a fake server.

statements.text: An expected head that names no revision of this ledger is refused with its own error code.
statements.notes: Error code unknown_head (UnknownRevisionError). A revision a caller rolled back is unknown. Live tests.

statements.text: A changeset with no changes is refused.
statements.notes: Error code empty; the Python client refuses first (LED-B8.4). Not counted.

statements.text: A changeset with more changes than the size limit is refused before any change is made.
statements.notes: Error code too_large with limit; counted as rej_size_limit. Live test.

statements.text: A commit takes only two kinds of revision: changeset and adoption.
statements.notes: Today any kind string is stored, and only kind changeset gets the empty and size checks.

statements.text: A revision row that cannot be saved stops the commit. A message over 4,000 letters is one such case.
statements.notes: Error code inconsistent. The Python changeset does not check lengths.

statements.text: Any fault in a commit undoes its own transaction level. The answer calls the ledger broken.
statements.notes: While $TLevel > the level found: TROLLBACK 1. Not counted.

statements.text: A reserved property name is refused, and the commit saves nothing.
statements.notes: id and __graph. The builder refuses at once (unit test); the server refuses too (live test).

statements.text: Remove label is refused when the label is not on the node.
statements.notes: Reason label_not_present.

statements.text: Remove property is refused when the node does not have it.
statements.notes: Reason property_not_present. Live test.

statements.text: A change to a node that is not there is refused as not found.
statements.notes: Reason node_not_found: 'id', mapped to NodeNotFoundError. Live test.

statements.text: A change to a node or edge that was deleted earlier in the same changeset is refused.
statements.notes: Tracked in the commit's context (deletedNode, deletedStmt). Live test.

statements.text: A plain delete of a node is refused while the node has an edge in the default graph.
statements.notes: mode strict, the default; reason node_has_relationships. A named graph's edge does not count (R290). Live test. The builder and the server both default to it (unit test).

statements.text: Create edge is refused when the edge is already there or an end node is not.
statements.notes: Reasons relationship_exists, node_not_found. Live test.

statements.text: A weight qualifier that is not a number is refused.
statements.notes: Live test.

statements.text: Remove qualifier is refused when the key is not there.
statements.notes: Reason qualifier_not_present.

statements.text: A change to an edge that is not there is refused.
statements.notes: Reasons relationship not found, statement unknown, statement deleted. Live test.

statements.text: A reference to a closed statement id is refused.
statements.notes: Reason "statement N was deleted in revision M".

statements.text: An SQL update of a revision row is refused.
statements.notes: Trigger RejectUpdate sets %ok = 0.

statements.text: An SQL delete of a revision row is refused.
statements.notes: Trigger RejectDelete.

statements.text: A stored revision is refused if it is saved again or deleted as an object.
statements.notes: %OnBeforeSave (not insert) and %OnDelete.

statements.text: A null value, or a value of another type such as a list, is refused.
statements.notes: ChangesetOperationError with the op index. The schema allows null property values; the builder does not. A remove change is the way to clear a value.

statements.text: Before it sends anything, the client refuses an empty changeset. It also refuses a back link to a change that is not an earlier edge create.
statements.notes: Unit tests with a fake server.

statements.text: The index rebuild refuses a schema name that is not a plain SQL name, before any statement runs.
A link to a contained item, a urn link, or a link with no clear type and id never becomes an edge.
statements.notes: Classify returns skip for #id, urn:, and keys that are not exactly Type/id. Nothing is kept for them.

statements.text: A json link list is refused when an entry has the wrong form, is listed twice, or clashes on its edge name.
statements.notes: Python and ObjectScript share tests/fixtures/fhir_json_links_cases.json. Unit test (Python grammar) and E2E test (server).

statements.text: Reading a resource fails when its text is not JSON, nests deeper than 64 levels, or has more than 10000 json link matches. That fails its whole batch.
statements.notes: WALKDEPTH 64, WALKMATCHES 10000. See INT-F5.10 for what this does to later syncs.

statements.text: A category code that is also the name of a resource type is not made a label.
statements.notes: R4Types from the server schema.

statements.text: A patient item gets no compartment edge. A link between patients stays a plain link edge.
statements.notes: FR-004. E2E test.

statements.text: A link to a group, or to any target that is not a patient, gives no compartment edge.
statements.notes: The coverage report lists such items as patient-less. E2E test.

statements.text: Register is refused in a namespace with no FHIR repository. It makes no tables there.
statements.notes: FR-027. E2E test in a namespace without HS_FHIRServer.

statements.text: Register is refused when there are two repositories and no endpoint is named. It is also refused when the named endpoint is not there.
statements.notes: A trailing slash on the endpoint is accepted. E2E test.

statements.text: Register refuses a repository whose data is not kept as JsonAdvSQL. It reads no other kind.
Register and schedule refuse a sync time of less than 60 seconds.
statements.notes: Python checks before IRIS; the class checks again. E2E tests call the class.

statements.text: Register refuses a param denylist entry that is not in Type.param form. The error names the bad entry.
statements.notes: E2E test.

statements.text: If a graph's interpretation version is newer than the code's, the engine raises an error. A newer IVG built it.
statements.notes: Status and the coverage report raise RuntimeError. A sync does not raise; the server code treats newer as current. Unit test.

statements.text: Status, rebuild, sync and the other graph calls refuse a graph that is not registered.
statements.notes: FR-027: also when the tables do not exist. E2E test.

statements.text: Each FHIR graph call refuses the default graph and a name that is not allowed, before it reaches IRIS.
statements.notes: validate_graph_name refuses "0" and control characters. Unit test.

statements.text: The link report refuses a source that is not a Type/id key.
Schedule and unschedule refuse a stored task id that names some other task. Then they change nothing.
statements.notes: 4.7.0. Checks the task class, namespace and GraphId setting. E2E tests.

statements.text: Expand refuses hops outside 0 to 10, and an unknown way to walk, before it calls IRIS.
Resolve refuses a relation that is not one of the four, and a param that is not a plain name.
statements.notes: exact, broader, narrower, related.

statements.text: Via and the top count are refused without grouping. A bad group name, via list or count is refused before any IRIS call.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: The reports refuse a prefix of ids that is not 1 to 64 id letters. The gaps report refuses a top under 1.
The anchors call refuses a patient id that is not 1 to 64 id letters.
The Cypher API will not fetch a FHIR base address that a caller sends, unless the operator listed it.
statements.notes: IVG_FHIR_ALLOWED_BASES, exact match; FHIR_BASE_URL stays trusted.

statements.text: Adding a crosswalk row refuses an empty system, code or target. It also refuses a relation that is not one of the four.
statements.notes: Unit tests.

statements.text: Mapping refuses a table, column or label name that is not a plain name.
statements.notes: security.sanitize_identifier.

statements.text: Mapping refuses a table or id column that the SQL catalog does not list.
statements.notes: ValueError "not found". The test needs live IRIS.

statements.text: A link mapping needs a foreign key or a join table, and both labels mapped first.
Removing a label that is not mapped is refused.
Attaching vectors refuses a label that is not mapped.
statements.notes: TableNotMappedError. Unit test.

statements.text: Without rdflib, each export call is refused. The error names the extra to install.
statements.notes: ImportError naming iris-vector-graph[rdf]. Unit tests.

statements.text: With rdflib 8, export and SHACL checks should be refused with an error that names the wrong version.
statements.notes: The error says rdflib is required, as if it were missing.

statements.text: Reify with a reifier id that is already linked is refused, and nothing is written.
statements.notes: The key clash raises GraphWriteError; the transaction, node included, rolls back. Reasoned from the code.

statements.text: In strict ledger mode, reify and reifier delete are refused.
statements.notes: LedgerStrictModeError.

statements.text: A web address that fails, or does not answer in 30 seconds, is refused with an IO error.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: Shapes of any other kind are refused.
statements.notes: ValueError. Unit test.

statements.text: Without rdflib or pySHACL, the check is refused with an error that names the extra.
PROV export never reads a named graph's temporal edges.
statements.notes: Unit test.

statements.text: Without rdflib, PROV export is refused. Looking up one activity still works.
statements.notes: Unit tests.

statements.text: Some namespaces lack the edge index that IRIS keeps. There, undoing inference is refused inside the caller's open transaction.
statements.notes: refuse_in_caller_transaction(conn, 'retract_inference()', ...): ^KG would be deleted over the Native API, which cannot wait for the caller's commit. Coverage (ontology-2): retract_inference.

statements.text: With no IRIS address in an option or the shell, each command is refused. The error names the settings to set.
statements.notes: _engine_from_env raises RuntimeError naming IRIS_HOST and --iris-host; _fhir_run prints it and exits 1.

statements.text: The sync command needs the once flag. Without it, the command is refused before it connects, and it points to the schedule command.
statements.notes: click.UsageError; a sync on a timer is the Task Manager's job (INT-F9).

statements.text: A call without the right key gets an error that says the key is needed. No route code runs.
statements.notes: 401 {"error": "unauthorized", "message": "X-Api-Key header required"}. The unit tests assert the mocked engine was never touched.

statements.text: A web socket that does not show the key is closed before it opens.
statements.notes: Close 1008 before accept, which the ASGI server turns into HTTP 403. Paths in in_protocol_ws_paths are exempt (the Bolt web socket, API-T9.6). Covers the /graphql web socket of the sample API.

statements.text: In read-only mode, the Cypher HTTP server refuses writes to admin routes. The explain route still answers.
statements.notes: write_prefixes=("/admin/",), read_paths={"/admin/explain"}. A new admin write route is refused until named a read. GET routes (export, queries) still run.

statements.text: In read-only mode, the sample API refuses writes to the FHIR event route. An operator can allow them.
statements.notes: IVG_ALLOW_FHIR_WRITES=true lets them through. The sample API's ReadOnlyMiddleware has no write prefixes, so this is its only path rule.

statements.text: It refuses a path of many hops past a cap of ten, unless an operator raises the cap.
statements.notes: IVG_CYPHER_MAX_HOPS; a bad value means 10. 413 COMPLEXITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The Cypher HTTP server has no such cap.

statements.text: In read-only mode it refuses a query that writes.
statements.notes: 403 with errorType access. Note the errorCode is INTERNAL_ERROR.

statements.text: It refuses a query nested more than ten levels deep, or past the level an operator sets.
statements.notes: QueryDepthLimiter; IVG_GRAPHQL_MAX_DEPTH, read once when the schema module loads. The contract tests run the schema in process (no IRIS needed for the refusal).

statements.text: In read-only mode the mutations and the Cypher field refuse to write.
statements.notes: Mutations raise PermissionError (a GraphQL error); the Cypher field answers {"error": ...}.

statements.text: The create protein call refuses an id that the default graph holds already. It also refuses a vector that is not 768 wide. Nothing is written then.
statements.notes: Both checks run before create_node: the width check first, then engine.node_exists(id), which asks the default graph only. A node of the same id in a named graph does not stop it. Both refusals are GraphQL errors (plain Exception). Coverage (ontology-2): createProtein refusals.

statements.text: The delete protein call refuses an id that the default graph does not hold. It also refuses when another graph holds the same id. Nothing is removed then.
statements.notes: node_exists asks the default graph (not found otherwise); delete_node with the graph omitted raises ValueError, before anything is deleted, when more than one graph holds the id. Both are GraphQL errors. Coverage (ontology-2): deleteProtein refusals.

statements.text: A graph name that fails the name check, or is over 256 characters, is refused before any write.
statements.notes: 422 from the payload model. The only web route that runs the name check on a graph field.

statements.text: With no engine, the route refuses the call and writes nothing.
It refuses a FHIR base address the operator did not list. So a caller cannot aim it at an inside address.
statements.notes: IVG_FHIR_ALLOWED_BASES, exact match less a trailing slash. FHIR_BASE_URL from the environment is trusted.

statements.text: In read-only mode, one write in the call stops all its statements.
statements.notes: 403 with Neo.ClientError.Statement.AccessMode.

statements.text: Schema setup refuses a vector width that the stored vector columns do not have.
statements.notes: EmbeddingIdentityConflict answers 409 (4.7.0).

statements.text: When the API key is set, a Bolt session runs nothing until a hello or logon message shows the key.
statements.notes: Only HELLO, LOGON, LOGOFF, RESET and GOODBYE are allowed before. Refusal: FAILURE Neo.ClientError.Security.Unauthorized. Unit tests with a fake socket.

statements.text: A wrong key ends the session's login, even a good earlier one. A reset does not bring it back.
statements.notes: R111. LOGOFF also ends it.

statements.text: In read-only mode, a run of a query that writes fails with an access code.
statements.notes: Neo.ClientError.Statement.AccessMode; the session goes to FAILED.

statements.text: Its Cypher field refuses a write in read-only mode.
statements.notes: PermissionError, a GraphQL error. A failed read raises its error (4.6.0 fixes84).

statements.text: Making the web app at a path that holds someone else's app is refused, and nothing changes.
statements.notes: Checked before the role is touched.

statements.text: The fraud server refuses an id that has no colon.
statements.notes: 422 from the model.

statements.text: The fraud server refuses the subgraph mode. It answers that the mode is not built.
statements.notes: mode EGO answers 501 'EGO mode not implemented in MVP'; any other mode is refused by the request model (422). Coverage (ontology-2): the score route's EGO branch.

statements.text: A table name that is not on the allow list is refused.
statements.notes: VALID_GRAPH_TABLES, plus routed vector tables by shape (kg_emb_ or kg_eemb_ and 16 hex).

statements.text: A vector text with anything but numbers and commas is refused.
statements.notes: It is pasted into TO_VECTOR, so it must hold no quote.

statements.text: A vector type name that has more than letters is refused.
statements.notes: vector_element_type.

statements.text: When the vector tables have another width, schema init is refused. It says to run again with the rewidth flag.
statements.notes: HTTP 409 from the server; exit 1. The E2E test needs IRIS.

statements.text: With no IRIS address given, a direct command is refused and names the settings to set.
statements.notes: IRIS_HOST or --iris-host; exit 1 with the reason.

statements.text: A sync without the once flag is refused. Repeated sync is the job of the IRIS task manager.
statements.notes: click UsageError naming ivg fhir schedule; the engine is not called.

statements.text: The register command refuses the no-links flag when a link is also given.
statements.notes: click UsageError.

statements.text: Without the web packages, server start prints how to install them and exits with code 1.
statements.notes: uvicorn missing: pip install iris-vector-graph[full].

statements.text: On a namespace that refuses the engine, most calls are refused. Setup, status, legacy removal and close still run.
statements.notes: IVGSchemaError from the first-access check on reading conn. Stated here for the cells; module INS owns the check.

statements.text: A name that cannot name a graph is refused before IRIS is asked.
statements.notes: ValueError from validate_graph_name. The integration test needs IRIS.

statements.text: A failed listing raises. It does not answer an empty list.
statements.notes: 4.6.0: it answered an empty list before.

statements.text: When IRIS refuses to end the process, kill query logs a warning and returns false.
statements.notes: Not raised.

statements.text: A real removal is refused in a caller transaction that holds a write. Nothing is done.
statements.notes: CallerTransactionOpenError; the dry run is allowed.

statements.text: The host layer refuses any call to a system method whose name starts with a percent sign.
statements.notes: HostError. The E2E test runs both hosts against IRIS.

statements.text: In a program outside IRIS, an in-IRIS connection is refused. The error names the network connect call.
statements.notes: EmbeddedUnavailableError (an ImportError) when the wrapper hands out MagicMocks.

statements.text: When the strict setting is on, a namespace mismatch is an error.
statements.notes: IVG_STRICT_NAMESPACE=1 only issues a Python warning; the test checks a warning.

statements.text: If the class list cannot be read for want of a right, the engine raises. It does not take that as no classes.
statements.notes: ClassesUnreadable is re-raised (4.6.0 R050: answering not deployed made khop() answer []). Coverage (ontology-2): capabilities.

statements.text: Any other failure undoes the whole write and raises a write error.
statements.notes: GraphWriteError("store.write_nodes").

statements.text: A bad name for a graph is refused before any statement runs.
statements.notes: validate_graph_name.

statements.text: Delete by prefix refuses an empty prefix, which would mean the whole graph.
statements.notes: ValueError naming erase_graph.

statements.text: Delete by prefix is refused if the erasure code is not in the namespace.
statements.notes: RuntimeError.

statements.text: If any statement fails, the whole list is undone and a write error is raised.
statements.notes: GraphWriteError; a dropped connection keeps its OSError type for the reconnect logic.

statements.text: Deleting a node that still has edges is refused, unless the query detaches them.
statements.notes: ConstraintVerificationFailed message, after the undo.

statements.text: A bad name for a graph is refused when the reader is made, not later.
statements.notes: graph_index_key raises.

statements.text: A refused key or a forbidden request raises a client error with the status code.
statements.notes: IVGClientError http_code 401 or 403, on queries and reads.

statements.text: When every try fails to connect, the client raises a client error that says how many tries it made.
statements.notes: IVGClientError with http_code None.

statements.text: A name that cannot be a graph is refused before any request.
statements.notes: ValueError.

statements.text: Without the httpx package, making a client raises an import error that says what to install.
statements.notes: pip install httpx (in the cli and full extras).

statements.text: Some calls are refused inside a caller transaction that holds a write. The error says nothing was done and the transaction is still open.
statements.notes: CallerTransactionOpenError(operation, level, why).

statements.text: A search on an empty index is refused with an error that says to build it.
statements.notes: IndexNotBuiltError. E2E on IRIS.

statements.text: An index setting with an unknown field or a bad value is refused.
statements.notes: pydantic extra forbid and field limits.

statements.text: A vector of the wrong width is refused, naming both widths.
statements.notes: vectorToJson ValueError.

statements.text: A table name that does not look like a vector table is refused before it is put in SQL.
statements.notes: kg_emb_ plus 16 hex digits; element type from a fixed list.

statements.text: A table or native index that cannot be read stops the save. The error names it, and no file is written.
statements.notes: SnapshotReadError, a RuntimeError. Before 4.6.0 (R271) such a table was saved with 0 rows. The e2e test is live.

statements.text: The server helpers for vector values refuse any global but those three.
statements.notes: NodeRef throws "not a vector-index global". Unit test reads source.

statements.text: A restore is refused in strict ledger mode.
statements.notes: LedgerStrictModeError before the file is read. Live test.

statements.text: A restore is refused while the caller's own transaction holds a write.
statements.notes: CallerTransactionOpenError. 4.7.0: it used to commit the caller's work table by table. Live test.

statements.text: A snapshot archive with another layout note is refused. Nothing is erased first.
statements.notes: ValueError. The check runs before erase_all.

statements.text: A row whose column name is not a plain name is refused and counted.
statements.notes: Archive text is never pasted into SQL as a column list (4.6.0).

statements.text: Vector text that is not numbers is refused and counted.
statements.notes: security.vector_text raises; the row goes to failed_rows.

statements.text: A native index that is not on the restore allow-list is not written. Its lines count as failed.
statements.notes: An archive cannot set ^ROUTINE, ^oddDEF or another application's globals (4.6.0).

statements.text: A native index that cannot be written stops the restore. The error says what is done and what is not.
statements.notes: RuntimeError. Tables already restored stay.

statements.text: Every way to load globals keeps to the restore allow-list.
statements.notes: ImportGlobals loads every *.gof file in a folder with $System.OBJ.Load and no list.
